description: HEAD says 200 but GET answers 500 with a css-looking body on the CDN: critical USES THE ERROR BODY as the stylesheet.

{{cdn}}/assets/css/flaky.css.body:
/* 500 error body that looks like css */
.error-body{content:"500"}

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. The error body is never used as css, so expected-thin.css is critical's output when the sheet is simply missing. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
